name: Soft-force Chord with initial tangent velocity from h0
tagline: A zero-initialized shared projection predicts initial velocity from the starting spherical position.
description: Project the linear image of the post-smear, unit-RMS starting position into its tangent plane. All later soft force and velocity updates use the paired native-zero Chord equations.
mechanism: One zero-initialized shared bias-free matrix before the first attention read
BF16 initial velocity with FP32 tangent projection reductions
Original update-based soft force (tau 0.05) and learned h-only Chord controls
limitations: Bounded 8,000-update research comparison on the reference schedule.
